landingV2.eyebrow: A new way to stay in sync
landingV2.description: School, driving lessons, sports, and everything in between. Keep every organization’s schedule in its own space—or see them together in a view that works for you.
landingV2.note: Built for people and the organizations they belong to
landingV2.visualLabel: Conceptual illustration of three organizations feeding into one unified schedule
landingV2.visualFootnote: Concept illustration · Product previews coming later
landingV2.sectionDescription: A simpler way to manage schedules across organizations—and keep everyone informed when plans change.
landingV2.featureOneDescription: Focus on a single organization, or bring your schedules together in one customizable view.
landingV2.featureTwoDescription: Create an organization, set up schedules, and invite members. Move beyond scattered sheets and group chats.
landingV2.featureThreeDescription: We’re building clearer ways to propose changes, coordinate decisions, and keep the right people informed.
landingV2.aboutTitle: A shared foundation. A personal experience.
landingV2.aboutDescription: Organizations stay in control of their schedules. Members choose how to see them. As SuperPlanify grows, coordination workflows will help everyone stay aligned.
landingV2.ctaDescription: Bring your schedules together and spend less time chasing updates.
